pipeline_mapping: Theoretical anchor for ISRU economics: 'gear ratio on cost' G and production mass-ratio phi are the two factors that decide whether lunar propellant beats Earth-launched; prior TEAs erred by choosing high-G architectures or ignoring phi. Tent-sublimation technology has phi an order of magnitude better than the viability threshold => conclusion: lunar propellant WILL be commercially viable and should lower the cost of everything else in space. Same author as metzger_zacny_2020 (drilling) — his UCF line is now our standing reference for both ISRU physics and its economics.
